ValidationRule.description: Prevents Opportunities with Type = "Auto-Renewal" from being moved to "Closed Won - Pending Approval" unless the 'Renewal Email Sent' checkbox is ticked. Ensures the required renewal communication has been completed and recorded before progressing.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Type, "Auto-Renewal"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Won – Pending Approval"), NOT(Renewal_Email_Sent__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: For Auto-Renewal opportunities, you must send the renewal email and tick the 'Renewal Email Sent' checkbox before progressing to Closed Won - Pending Approval.
